candidates.claim: The CORP_IN ACL, bound to the corp interface, permits tcp/22 from 192.168.30.0/24 (CORP) to 10.10.99.0/24 (MGMT) as its first entry, so CORP can open connections directly into the MGMT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the fw-01 CORP_IN line permitting tcp/22 to 10.10.99.0/24 so that CORP reaches MGMT only through approved services.

candidates.claim: Traffic from CORP to the MGMT side on tcp/22 is effectively permitted by CORP_IN, which is not one of the approved cross-zone services (A1 to A7).
candidates.remediation: Remove the CORP_IN tcp/22 permit to MGMT, since no approved service allows CORP to reach MGMT.

candidates.claim: The fw-01 access-list CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 is present in the current snapshot but not in the approved baseline and must be reported for reconciliation.
candidates.remediation: Confirm whether the CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 is authorized; if it is not, remove it, and if it is, record it in the approved baseline.
